206-2023-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-5295-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

654-2034-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2034-2577-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Repeat from step 4.

4002-4331-4993-7692.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.

Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6608-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

486-2388-6568-6587.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3490-6822-7256.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2034-3490-6822-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

568-2776.description:
Float at least {15}{U}{U}.
Cast Doubling Cube by paying {2}.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling the amount of mana in your mana pool. This will result in you adding at least {10}{U}{U}.
Cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Doubling Cube and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
568-2776.notes: You can cast Capsize to bounce any number of permanents with the added mana. You can also do this during each of your turns.

141-2292-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

460-539-962.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Pir.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3062-3693-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

5256-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2919-3525-4773.description:
Activate Overgrown Arch by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Overgrown Arch.
Repeat.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
When Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2713-3263-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

3197-4050-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Herd Baloth.
3197-4050-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-4050-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding one mana of any color.
When the Beast dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 2.

4996-5878-5879.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus (one plus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive).
4996-5878-5879.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cradle of Vitality triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to put a number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive equal to the life you gained.
At the beginning of the next upkeep, Walking Archive triggers, causing the active player to draw cards equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
If the player attempts to draw from an empty library, they lose the game.
If they didn't lose the game, the player will attempt to draw a card during their draw step and lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.

505-1558-1908-3263.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Izoni with haste.
Put the token Izoni into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Izoni token enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1770-4499-4939.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

859-2576-4613.description:

Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

527-641-2178-5220.notablePrerequisites:
There is not a creature on the battlefield with power 6 or greater.
Thornbite Staff attached to Selvala.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-641-2178-5220.description:
Cast Kroxa by paying {B}{R}.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, as well as Selvala.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding {3}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, causing you to sacrifce it.

Resolve the Selvala trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kroxa on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and then lose three life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Selvala trigger from step 2, causing you to draw Kroxa from your library.
Repeat.

Put Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Machine God's Effigy's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
